stories.title: Red Sox-Cubs finale, moved due to Boston weather, set for Sun. at Tropicana
stories.summary: The Red Sox and Cubs will play their regular-season finale Sunday afternoon at Tropicana Field after the league relocated their series from Boston because of the forecast for inclement weather.

stories.title: SEC irked LSU is trying to dismiss lawsuit with concerns 'unresolved'
stories.summary: The SEC is "deeply disappointed" LSU tried to dismiss its lawsuit against the university stemming from an attempt to add former NFL players to the Tigers' roster.

stories.title: White Sox's Montgomery sets single-season strikeout record with 224
stories.summary: White Sox infielder Colson Montgomery set the record for most strikeouts in a single season with 224 on Friday.

stories.title: Yankees, Red Sox to meet in playoffs for 7th time
stories.summary: The Yankees and Red Sox both talked up the clubs' long-standing rivalry with mutual respect ahead of their best-of-three wild-card series.

stories.title: Kyrie ready to 'kick some butt' after lengthy ACL recovery
stories.summary: Kyrie Irving said he is under no physical restrictions from the torn ACL in his left knee that sidelined him 19 months ago, an injury that he called "probably the best thing that happened to me."
